meta.solver: moleculeRHF defaults (SAD + core guesses, Hessian, stability probe) — lab/mathworker.js ensureSolve's call
meta.conventions: chemist's (ij|kl) = ∫∫ φ_i*(1) φ_j(1) r12⁻¹ φ_k*(2) φ_l(2); canonical unique = i ≤ j, k ≤ l, (ij) ≤ (kl); SAO = unit eigenvectors of the Löwdin-frame projectors mapped back by S^{-1/2}

H2O.geometrySource: CCCBDB experimental r(O–H) = 0.9578 Å, ∠HOH = 104.5° (the window's original preset, frozen)

frame.convention: Mulliken 1955 (planar C2v): z = the C2 axis (O toward the H midpoint), x PERPENDICULAR to the molecular plane (molecule in yz)

live.centred: cell-centred (half-integer centres, no centre on any coordinate plane)

nodeCentredContrast.centred: node-centred (a centre on every coordinate plane)

oracle.note: PySCF re-orients the molecule into its own frame, so B1/B2/B3 names may permute; the multisets are the comparison

C6H6.geometrySource: CCCBDB experimental r(C–C) = 1.39 Å, r(C–H) = 1.09 Å, D₆ₕ, hydrogens at radius 2.48 Å (the window's original preset, frozen) — THE CAP

frame.convention: z = C6 axis (ring normal), x through carbon 0; C2' and sigma_v through atoms, C2'' and sigma_d through bond midpoints (pi = a2u + b2g + e1g + e2u)

C6h.gradingRule: −k_p + k_q − k_r + k_s ≡ 0 (mod 6) and the σh parities multiply to +1

D6h.partnerLabelling: each D6h isotypic component split by the D2h label of its partner (E1g → B2g + B3g, E2g → Ag + B1g, E1u → B2u + B3u, E2u → Au + B1u)

piRing.reading: ε_k = F̃(k)/S̃(k): the Hückel/Bloch diagonalisation of the live π Fock block by the C6 characters, no eigensolver; k = 0 ↔ a2u, ±1 ↔ e1g, ±2 ↔ e2u, 3 ↔ b2g

live.centred: cell-centred (half-integer centres, no centre on any coordinate plane)

nodeCentredContrast.centred: node-centred (a centre on every coordinate plane)

oracle.note: PySCF re-orients the molecule into its own frame, so B1/B2/B3 names may permute; the multisets are the comparison
